name: claude-auto-split-fix
displayName: Claude Code — Fix for New-Tab Auto-Splitting
description: Unofficial. Claude Code opens its tab in a new editor group, forcing a split — this moves it back into your active group.

configuration.title: Claude Code — Fix for New-Tab Auto-Splitting

claudeAutoSplitFix.enabled.description: Move a newly opened Claude Code tab into the preceding editor group when Claude creates a new split for it.

claudeAutoSplitFix.restoreDelayMs.description: Delay before correcting Claude's editor-group placement. Increase this if Claude recreates or relocks the split.

claudeAutoSplitFix.diagnostics.description: Record tab and group events in the Claude Auto-Split Fix output channel.
